headers.//: Baseline hardening. HSTS is already set by the platform; these three are not. No CSP, deliberately — the page loads Google Fonts, CARTO tiles and the YouTube IFrame API, and a policy written without measuring those would break the map or the clips rather than protect anyone.
Do not hand the full URL to third parties. The site promises not to track people; leaking the page they came from to every tile and font request would undercut that for no benefit.
We frame YouTube; nobody needs to frame us.

Clip audio and vendored libraries are content-addressed and never change in place, so they can be cached hard. They were being served must-revalidate, which meant a round trip for every 240KB clip on every play.
